instruction: Candid black and white medium full shot of a city embankment on an overcast day. On the right, the man with curly hair and a dark coat (R1) leans against a stone barrier, facing left. On the left, the woman in the black cap and dark coat (R2) stands close, facing him. She holds his arms while he gently grasps her wrists, their eyes locked in an intimate moment. The background shows a soft-focus city street with distant buildings. Soft, diffused daylight illuminates the scene, casting gentle shadows.
